result.topic_en: Euler tests the trial value t = 200 by computing, with common logarithms, the successive terms of the series P and P' and their running partial sums, in order to decide whether this value is too large or too small.

items.quote: visuri, vtrum iste valor iusto sit maior, an minor
items.english: in order to see whether this value is larger or smaller than the correct one

items.quote: Quod si enim hinc valor formulae nostrae $P(1+Q')-QP'$ prodierit positiuus, id erit indicio, istum valorem $t=200$ esse nimis paruum; sin autem prodierit negatiuus, numerum $t$ diminui oportebit.
items.english: For if the value of our formula P(1+Q')-QP' comes out positive, this will indicate that the value t=200 is too small; but if it comes out negative, the number t must be decreased.

items.quote: Sumamus igitur $t=200$ et calculus pro seriebus $P$ et $P'$ ita stabit:
